tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (nga )༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
(nga )༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /

tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du 'khor lo bde mchog bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus rang gi sems pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog tu gyur par bsgom/ de yang sku mdog sngon po padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa gri gug 'dzin pas phyogs bcur sdigs shing*/ g.yon pas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal yod pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis ka stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa zung 'jug gi sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar bsgom/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ bsam/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas 'khor lo bde mchog la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba rang gi mdun du spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ yo ga shuddhasarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ gis rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de ltar lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de yid mnyam par bzhag sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las yig 'bru 'phros pa yab kyi zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi mkha' nas thon/ yab kyi gsang gnas su zhugs nas 'khor ba'i 'od kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs rang gi rgyud la zhugs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus pa bzla'o// de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa byed par 'dod na/ mchod pa bshams pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas ma dag pa bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo'i sgra rnams ngo bo bzang zhing nam mkha' gang bar bskyed/ de nas mdun du dmigs pa'i rten yod dam med kyang rung ste/ rang gis bsgoms pa ltar 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba bskyed pa la snga ma ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bstim/ de la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra samba ra maṇḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī zhes thams cad la sbyar la/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās mchod yon/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badzra gande āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab/ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo dbul/ de nas nang mchod sngar bzhin bsang zhing sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyed/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ mtheb srin gyis gtor zhing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa mchod par bzhes/ zhes rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa thams cad mchod par bzhes/ zhes brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ rang gi sngags kyis/ yi dam dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod par bzhes/ zhes pas de dag la mchod nas/ lce/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg pas rang gi lus kyi lha mchod nas/ chos skyong srung ma dang 'byung po thams cad mchod/ ces pas de dag la dbul lo// de nas/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod do// de nas gtor ma sbyangs pa gong gi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs pas mdun bskyed kyi he ru ka dang lha thams cad la mchod par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ ā ralli hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ snga ma ltar mchod nas/ bdag gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i phud mchod gral dang*/ gtor ma la phul bas lha dang 'byung po rnams mchod nas/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rdzas las kyi slob las/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'du ba rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa yang*// rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du bzhes// zhes pas drang*/ len pa pos/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i// de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal// zhes brjod cing blang*/

phud kyis sngar ltar mchod nas/ rang gi snying gar bla ma dang lha/ lte bar chos skyong dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad dmigs la mchod par bsam zhing longs spyad/ kha zas kyang de dang 'dra bar longs spyad do// thabs kyi rdzas la ba la/ shes rab kyi rdzas la ma da na/ bza' ba la kri pi ta zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod par bya'o// gnas skabs thams cad du lha'i rnal 'byor ma nyams par bya'o// bza' btung gis tshims pa dang*/ lhag ma bsdus pa nang mchod kyis kha phru btab nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba linta bhakṣa sī swā hās lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la byin nas/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa 'dis ni lha mo 'di dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces pa dang*/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pas dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos la/ oṃ badzra muḥ zhes brjod pas mdun bskyed gshegs su gsol la/ rang gi gnas gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis bsrungs nas/ las kyi rjes bsdus la/ ci bde bar spyad do// tshogs kyi mchod pa'i cho ga'o// spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/ oṃ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha/ āḥzhes brjod pas brjod pa dang grags pa thams cad sngags/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rtog pa'i 'du 'phro thams cad ting nge 'dzin/ de thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bsams la yul rnams la sdang zhen med par spyad do// nub mo nyal ba'i tshe chos thams cad 'ga' yang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal/ nangs par ldang ba'i tshe lha'i sku'i nga rgyal gyis ldang ngo*// de ltar rgyun du rnal 'byor du byed cing*/ dam tshig rnam par dag pa la gnas pa ni ring por mi thogs par he ru ka chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// tshul 'di sngags 'chang 'phags pa la// dge bshes jo sras phag mchu yis// bskul ba'i don du sgyur ba yi// dge bas sangs rgyas thob par shog

/sa mo yos kyi lo dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes lnga'i nyin par chu mig dpal gyi sde tshan du/ sangs rgyas grags kyis yi ge byas nas sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bde mchog lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs bzhugs// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bde mchog 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa'i rang byin rlabs kyi rim pa la don gnyis te/ dang po byin rlabs kyi sgo dbye ba dang*/ de'i rgyun nyams su blang ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ sgra don bshad de nges shes bskyed pa dang*/ dngos so// dang po ni/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i phyag len bzhin nam/ mi nus na lhan skyes kyi sgom bzlas tshar nas tshogs gtor byin gyis brlabs nas/ lhag ma yan chad tshar nas/ 'das pa'i gtor ma gzhug go /gnyis pa ni/ bde mchog 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa zhes pa'i don mtshon byed dang*/ mtshon bya gnyis kyi sgra don bshad do// gsum pa dngos ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad zla la bla ma dang bde mchog tha mi dad pa la/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mngon sum du blta/ de nas maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba gdab ste/ bla ma'i rjes su/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsol// lus kyi dri ma sbyang ba dang*// de nyid bde mchog bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de'i don bla mas bshad do// de nas bla ma'i dpral bar dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku yi ngo bo oṃ dkar po de rang gi dpral ba na sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi ngo bo nyid kyi oṃ la thim pas/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag oṃ bde ba chen po'i rgyun du gyur te/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ bde lhan gyis gyur te lus snang stong gi ye shes su ngo sprad la bsgom/ dngos su bla mas bum chu spyi bor blugs/

ku shas dpral bar bzhag go /bum dbang ngo*// yang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gsung*// la sogs pa gsum 'gre/ lan gsum/ de nas āḥsangs rgyas dang sems can gyi gsung dang ngag tu dran par byas la/ āḥl āḥthim pas/ gsang dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag snying ga yan chad gang*/ gsal stong gi ye shes su ngo sprad la dar cig bsgom/ dngos su bla mas g.yon pa'i khyor bar chu blugs/ ku shas mgrin par bzhag gsang dbang ngo*// yang sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin thugs// la sogs lan gsum/ de nas hūm̐ gnyis sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi thugs dang sems su shes par byas la/ hūm̐ la hūm̐ thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag lte ba yan chad gang*/ bde stong gi ngo sprad la dar cig bsgom/ ku shas snying gar bzhag gsum pa'o// sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs rang bzhin// sogs gsum gyis/ 'bru gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum du shes par byas la/ gnas gsum la thim pas/ bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag lus thams cad bde bas gang*/ phyag rgya chen por ngo sprad la dar cig bsgom/ spros pa la dga' na dbang chu bzhin zhib par bshad do// gnyis pa de'i rgyun nyams su blang ba ni/ lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs ltar skad cig gis mdun du bskyed la/ de dang bla ma tha mi dad la dbang sngar bzhin blang*/ de nas rang lhan skyes su gsal ba'i thugs dkar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi 'od 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad bde mchog tu byas la/ de thams cad kyang rnam pa gsal ba/ ngo bo bde ba/ rang bzhin stong pa ste nyams su myong ba gsal ba'i cha'ang ma 'gags la/ rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par bsgom/ rab kyi'o// yang na snod bcud lhar byas pa yan chad 'dra la/ de nas snod bcud yum la bsdu/

de yab/ de zla ba/ de ha/ de mgo bo/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da/ de yang rim gyis thim nas rdo rje sems dpa'i 'od gsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la khri le gzhag go /ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gnyis thun rer bsgoms te 'bring gi'o// tha mas ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gnyis ka thun res 'jog tu bsgom/ rdzogs so// //lhan skyes kyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i lag len tho re tsam bsgrigs pa 'di/ ras pa shes rab 'od sngags la cher dad kyang blo'i mthu chung bas nyung la tshang ba zhig zhu zer nas/ g.yas ru shangs kyi lu gu sdong du sa skya paṇḍi tas sbyar ba'o// bde mchog gi dbang ma thob pa la mi gnang bar gda'o// ༈ /bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bde chen 'char ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa yis// dngos kun yang dag sdom mdzad pa// bla ma he ru ka dpal la// btud nas de yi byin rlabs 'bri// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas dben par yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i dus/ stegs bu'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar maṇḍa lar padma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar nyi gdan la tshom bu sngon po gcig bkod/ de'i mdun du mchod gtor dang tshogs kyi yo byad/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ bum pa bcud ldan sogs dgos pa'i rigs rnams 'du bya/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas sngon 'gro gtor ma gtang gnas yo byin rlabs dang*/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi spyi ltar sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab ltar nyams su blangs rjes/ tshom bu dang*/ bum pa gnyis ka la dmigs te sumbhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇḍal gyi dbus dang*/ bum pa'i nang du pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/

skad cig gis dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po sogs nas/ shuddho3haṃ/ mdun bskyed dang bum pa'i lha la gnyis su med par thim/ spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ oṃ shrī tsakra sambha ra arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ chos dbyings rnam dag sogs kyis bstod/ mdun bskyed dang bum pa'i lha'i thugs rgyud bskul bar dmigs te bzlas pa ci 'grub dang*/ bum pa'i lha zhu ba las/ chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bsam/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs/ mchod bstod/ gtor 'bul tshogs mchod lhag ma'i bar gzhung ltar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ dbang gis smin pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod par/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal 'debs pas mtshams sbyar te/ de la rgyud sde bzhi'i mthar thug pa bla med ma rgyud he ru ka'i rigs rnal 'byor gsang mtha' 'khor lo bde mchog gi skor la/ 'phags yul du grub pa'i slob dpon chen po lū dril nag gsum gyis rim par bkral bas mtshon te lugs srol mi 'dra ba ji snyed cig byung zhing*/ gangs can gyi ljongs su'ang ci rigs par 'gyur ba la brten nas ye shes mchog brnyes pa du ma zhig byon pa'i phyir byin rlabs kyi tshan ka gzhan las khyad par du gyur pa ste/ de la'ang dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis las 'dir phyi ma/ de la'ang slob dpon chen po rdo rje dril bu dang*/ dga' rab rdo rje dang*/ a bha yā ka ra nas brgyud pa'i lugs srol gsum du bzhugs pa las/ 'dir grub pa'i slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje nas paṇa grub chen po rdo rje gdan pa sogs las brgyud pa'i man ngag gi bka' srol gtso bor gyur pa'i sgo nas byin rlabs kyi rim pa zab mo sgrub pa la gsum/ sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ sgra don bshad de nges shes bskyed pa dang*/

dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o// dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi bya ba ste kho bos legs par grub zin/ gnyis pa sgra don bshad de nges shes bskyed pa ni/ ji skad du rgyud las/ lhan skyes thabs kyi mtshan nyid ni// dpal ldan bde mchog las gzhan med// ces gsungs pa ltar/ mtshon byed dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyag dang*/ gtso 'khor sogs kyi rnam 'phrul mtha' yas par 'char ba thams cad kyi spro gzhi ni bcom ldan lhan cig skyes pa thabs shes kha sbyor gyi skur snang ba 'di nyid yin la/ des chos thams cad kyi 'char gzhi gnyug ma'i sems lhan cig skyes pa bde stong zung 'jug gi ye shes gsal bar mtshon pas na/ thabs kyi rim pa gzhan las ches 'phags pa'i phyir brda don la nges shes khyad par can bskyed 'tshal/ gsum pa byin rlabs dngos ni/ de lta bu'i sgra don gyis mtshon pa'i ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren du gyur pa byin rlabs kyi rim pa zab mo bsgrub pa'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri'i steng du mdun bskyed dang tha mi dad pa'i bla ma dpal bde mchog 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po sogs nas/ snang la rang bzhin med pa/ spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan pa la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur gsal ba'i spyan sngar byin rlabs kyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa la/ thog mar bla ma rin po ches bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// dpa' bo chen po bdag la dgongs// lus kyi dri ma sbyong ba dang*// de nyid bde mchog bdag la stsol// ces gsol ba btab nas/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi dpal 'khor lo bde mchog tha mi dad pa'i dpral bar dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par gsung gi ngo bo āḥdamar po/ thugs dkar thugs kyi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po rnams dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi ngo bo oṃ aḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la gus 'dud mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi spyi bo'i oṃ las oṃ dkar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i oṃ la thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag oṃ bde ba chen po'i chu rgyun du gyur te/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ bde lhan gyis gyur te lus snang stong 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur par mos la/ ye shes de'i rgyun bskyang ba'i slad cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de brtan par bya ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis kyang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ yi ge bdun pa bzla bzhin pas bum pa spyi bor bzhag ku shas bum chu blangs te dpral bar gtor/ des bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pa yin no// gsang ba'i dbang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gsung*// dpa' bo= /ngag gi= /de nyid bde mchog= /ces gsol ba btab pas slob dpon gyi mgrin pa'i āḥlas āḥdamar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim pas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag āḥbade ba chen po'i chu rgyun du gyur te/ snying ga yan chad gang*/ bde lhan gyis gyur te gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos te cung zad re mnyam par 'jog mdzod/

de brtan pa'i slad du bum chu khyor ba g.yon du sbyin/ ku shas mgrin par gtor/ des gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pa'o// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du gsol ba= sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin thugs// dpa' bo= /yid kyi= /de nyid= /ces gsol ba btab pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ sngon po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag hūm̐ bde ba chen po'i chu rgyun du gyur te/ lte ba yan chad gang*/ bde lhan gyis gyur te bde stong zung 'jug gi ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos te cung zad re mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ de brtan pa'i slad du bum chu snying gar gtor/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pa'o// dbang bzhi pa'i slad du/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin thugs// dpa' bo= /yid kyi= /de nyid= /ces gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyi gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las/ oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum gsal ba la thim pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum bde ba chen po'i chu rgyun du gyur te lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ bde lhan gyis gyur te/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bzhin du brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i de kho na nyid rgyud la skyes par mos te cung zad re mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ de brtan pa'i slad du bum chu gnas gsum du gtor zhing khrus bya/ des dbang bzhi pa thob pa'o// de'i ngang las khyed rang rnams skad cig gis paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po sogs nas/

snang la rang bzhin med pa gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ nas bskor ba rang rang gi mdun du spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ nas/ shuddho3haṃ/ khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim pa'i spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' re res dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni lta ba sgom pa'i rjes su gnang ba'o// sngags kyi bzlas lung gi slad du/ slob dpon la gus 'dud mdzad pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig la thim pa'i mos pa dang bcas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ hrīḥha sogs/ bcom ldan bdag la dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs spyi ltar bya/ de ni sngags kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba ste/ de rnams kyi sgo nas byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par grub nas/ de'i rgyun nyams su blang ba ni zhes pa nas/ res 'jog tu bsgom zhes pa'i bar dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi ta'i gsung rab las 'byung ba ltar gdams/ mjug dam tshig khas blang sogs spyi ltar byas la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par byas la dga' ba gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas spyod lam la 'jug go /bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa yi// byin rlabs zla ba nor bu'i 'od// gang du snang bas bde chen gyi// ye shes 'char ba nyid gyur cig /ces pa'ang bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos/ rang 'dra'i blo dman rnams la phan pa'i slad du dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi ta'i gsung rab gsal byed dang bcas pa'i dgongs don ji lta bar bklag pas grub par bsdebs pa dge legs su gyur cig/
